summary: Frontend regression after useState crash fix + employeesAPI.getAll rename + new MonthYearPicker drill-down datepicker. All 10 requested flows pass cleanly. No crash, no console errors observed.
passed_tests: 1) Login with María (Admin) via quick button succeeds, no red screen / no 'Cannot read properties of null (reading useState)' overlay. URL=/ shows dashboard.
2) /employees lists 8 employees from BBDD: María García López, Juan Rodríguez, Laura Sánchez, Carlos Mendoza, Ana Martínez, Roberto Fernández, Patricia Ruiz, Diego Morales (table has 8 rows).

3) Click on row #1 (Juan Rodríguez) → navigates to /perfil/2 and header displays 'Juan Rodríguez - Senior Developer - Desarrollo' (NOT María). formData is correctly refreshed for the clicked employee.
4) Registros tab loads. Timeline shows 24/24 hour labels (0..23 horizontal columns).
5) datepicker-trigger opens datepicker-popover with 12 month buttons (datepicker-month-0..11). Trigger label 'Mayo 2026' visible.
6) datepicker-year-trigger switches view to years grid: 12 year buttons (3x4) rendered. Clicking a year returns to months view with 12 months still rendered.

7) Clicking a different month (Junio when current was Mayo) closes popover and updates trigger label from 'Mayo 2026' to 'Junio 2016' (year was changed to 2016 first via year drill-down then month=Junio). Drill-down behavior correct.
8) registros-period-select changed to 'Semanal' via native select; weekly day labels (Lun..Dom / L-M-X-J-V-S-D) are rendered (13 matches indicating weekly grid visible).

9) Horarios tab on /perfil/2 renders the MonthYearPicker (datepicker-trigger), popover opens correctly, plus month-prev, month-next, and assign-schedule-btn data-testids all present. Monthly calendar visible with horario normal segments and 'Vacaciones 2026-05-10 → 2026-05-12'.

10) Final crash check: no useState/null overlay present after full navigation. Empleado may have no segments (segment-bar-* not found for Juan) which is acceptable; no errors raised during hover attempts.
critical_code_review_comments: MonthYearPicker drill-down works correctly. Minor UX note: when user opens year drill-down and selects a year, then picks a month, the picker also commits the new year (e.g. label became 'Junio 2016'). This is consistent with shadcn-style drill-down pickers; confirm this matches product intent (vs. just navigating the months grid for browsing).
EmployeeProfile.jsx is large (~900+ lines per file_of_reference). Consider splitting tabs into separate components for maintainability (Registros, Horarios already split which is good).
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing BBDD with 8 employees and existing horario assignments for employee 2 (Juan).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All previously-reported issues (React useState crash + employees list empty due to wrong API method name) are fully resolved. MonthYearPicker exists at /app/frontend/src/components/MonthYearPicker.jsx and is used in both EmployeeProfile Registros tab and EmployeeHorariosTab. data-testids: datepicker-trigger, datepicker-popover, datepicker-year-trigger, datepicker-month-{0..11}, datepicker-year-{Y}, datepicker-day-{D}. Backend was not retested per request.
